description: Defines the TrustStoreWin class, an implementation of TrustStore that interacts with Windows certificate stores for trust management. Includes nested CertStores struct for managing certificate store collections, and methods for initialization, testing, and trust retrieval.

classes.name: TrustStoreWin
classes.description: An implementation of TrustStore that uses Windows certificate stores to find trust anchors, ignoring Windows built-in trust anchors. Thread-safe and includes methods for creation, initialization, and trust evaluation.

classes.name: TrustStoreWin::CertStores
classes.description: A struct managing multiple certificate store handles, with factory methods for different testing and collection scenarios.

methods.name: CreateForTesting
methods.description: Creates a TrustStoreWin instance with specified CertStores for testing purposes.

methods.name: InitializeStores
methods.description: Loads user settings from Windows CertStores, may not read all stores if errors occur.

methods.name: SyncGetIssuersOf
methods.description: Retrieves issuer certificates for a given certificate.

methods.name: GetTrust
methods.description: Determines trust level for a given certificate.

methods.name: MaybeInitializeAndGetImpl
methods.description: Ensures stores are initialized and returns pointer to internal implementation.
